provenance.title: Library book rentals
provenance.domain: book rental service (FARM: FastAPI + Beanie, repository/service layers)
provenance.trimmed: kept models, DTOs, repositories, services, rental router and exceptions; dropped auth/security, email + RabbitMQ workers, app wiring (the notification queue becomes reported messages)
provenance.mapping: BookModel/PersonModel/BookRentalModel -> Book/Person/Rental nodes; book_id/person_id string FKs -> edges Person -[Rents]-> Rental -[RentalOf]-> Book; repository+service methods -> walkers; NotFound/Conflict exceptions -> reported {status, detail}; RabbitMQ overdue messages -> reported list
provenance.hidden_tests: no upstream tests; hidden tests cover copy accounting (create/return), 404/409 paths, detail join, and the overdue sweep, uuid-tagged
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude), validated by convert_build
